basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used in the earlier special grade batches. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise. A corpus that writes a different glyph form is never selected, even when it carries fewer flagged strokes, as in batch 11's 倩.

疐.reason: Ja writes the inner vertical of the 叀 body before the bar across it (two strokes over 60°, max 97°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 20°.

冢.reason: Ja writes the legs of the 豕 body in a different order (two strokes over 60°, max 112°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 28°.

摧.reason: Ja writes the long vertical of the 隹 body before its two bars (three strokes over 60°, max 100°); MM writes the bars first and leaves one, the top-right tick.

褫.reason: Ja writes the long left sweep of the 虍 body before the bar above it (two strokes over 60°, max 91°); the simplified file follows the dictionary with no stroke over 46°.
